source.title: The Island Behind the Online Casino Epidemic
source.note: English history of Curaçao's licensing system, ending with the Casino Secrets reporting. Summaries paraphrase what the video says; they are claims, not findings of this project.

mentions.claim: Stake was founded in 2017 by Ed Craven and Bijan Tehrani; it runs on cryptocurrency, has offices in Melbourne and its licence is tied to a company registered in Curaçao.
Blaze, which had Neymar as its ambassador, is named as one of the most visible Curaçao-licensed betting brands sponsoring Brazilian football.
1xBet has sponsored top football leagues, has been sanctioned several times for targeting countries where it had no right to operate, and holds a Curaçao licence.

Casino Secrets: a Berlin security researcher opened an account on the new authority's portal with a fake company and a Gmail address; the leaked documents cover hundreds of licensed companies and nearly 800 owners, with licences granted while ownership questions were open.
